While Kellogg's versions of ChatGPT and Claude do not train on your inputs, confidential student information and regulated research data should still not be entered.

evidence.quote: A: No. Conversations created within a Kellogg-provided AI workspace stay within that workspace. They do not follow you to a personal account or another workspace, even if you use the same email address. If your Kellogg subscription is cancelled, your access to the workspace ends, or you leave Kellogg, you will no longer have access to the conversations and other content stored there.
